final_draft.answer: Changes to the default branch (main) of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need two approving reviews before they can be merged. The rule applies to administrators too.
final_draft.note: The approved answer (CC8.1, valid until 2027-11-16) matches a live GitHub check of harborlight/app taken at 2026-11-16T16:04:11Z. That check shows the main branch is protected, needs 2 approving reviews, and the rule applies to administrators. Both sources cover only the harborlight/app repository. If the customer is asking about other repositories, we have no evidence for those.

arguments.query: code review approvals before merge to main branch

answer:814e432a-32c8-4b88-880b-f208f6924: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:6dd7a3e2-6acb-4ccc-9092-ce0670b3c: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:20409821-dd84-4591-912c-1762e45a9: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:d6434953-9608-4f8c-8332-2bf104424: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:fd4b4f21-50ee-48f0-9016-9b67b5158: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
evidence:31524c4e-6a56-4c9b-8ba5-abd549a: Branch main of harborlight/app is protected: a change needs 2 approving reviews before it can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators. Observed 2026-11-16 16:04 UTC.
